formula: factor = sign(skew_120) * log(1 + abs(skew_120)), where skew_120 = rolling_skew(close.pct_change(), 120)
code:
def factor_skewness_log_compress(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    returns = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    skew = returns.rolling(120, min_periods=120).skew()
    factor = np.sign(skew) * np.log1p(np.abs(skew))
    df_copy["factor_skewness_log_compress"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_skewness_log_compress"]
description: Preserves the parent's core 120-day rolling skewness of daily returns as the slow-moving return distribution asymmetry mechanism. Mutates the parent's tanh compression to sign*log1p(abs(skew)): this expands moderate skew deviations more gradually than tanh, preserving the monotonic rank ordering that underpins RankIC/RankICIR stability while reducing over-compression near zero and potentially improving raw IC/ICIR. A single lightweight modifier, no second independent factor.
